# Sample Restaurant v0.04

Restaurant v0.04 is a content engine: a menu registry generates HTML menu pages, Markdown pages, item routes, MenuItem schema, MenuSection schema, sitemap entries, and behind-the-dish articles.

## Key routes
- /menu rich HTML menu
- /menu.md markdown menu
- /registry.json source-of-truth registry
- /items/101 item page by ID
- /items/101?format=md item markdown
- /menu/starters/seared-scallops clean item route
- /menu/starters/seared-scallops.md clean markdown route
- /articles/behind-the-seared-scallops article tie-in

## Guardrails
Preview only. No production routes. No custom domains. No account IDs. No secrets.
